rationale: Lycopolitan qualitative of ⲕⲁ ⲣⲱ⸗ 'be silent.' Listed in chapter 11 alongside Peace, Day, Rest as alternate names for the Fast — all expressing the Manichaean valuation of the Fast as a state of calm/cessation. 'Stillness' preserves the verbal-cessation root better than 'Silence' (which is more vocal-specific).

Agentive compound: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ⲥⲱⲟⲩϩ ('gather, assemble') + ⲁⲍⲟⲩⲛ ('inward, to within'). Parallels other ⲣⲉϥ- agentives (ⲣⲉϥ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher'). Preserves the spatial 'inward' motion crucial to Manichaean soul-gathering soteriology.
Lycopolitan directional ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ = Sah. ⲉϩⲣⲁⲓ̈ 'upward.' The editor's restoration as [ⲡ] may be a misreading of [ⲣ]; ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ ⲁⲡⲁⲅⲁⲑⲟⲛ 'upward to the Good' fits standard Manichaean ascent vocabulary.
